protocol.design: 24 fixed cases: three session-rule families, both/long-only directions, half/full opening-range stop, 2R/3R target, one NQ contract. Completed five-minute candles. One entry attempt per session, noon flattening. No protective-stop retuning.
protocol.selection: Evaluate each case continuously within 2010–2015, 2016–2019, 2020–2023 NQ training blocks. Risk/capital reset at block boundaries only. Rank by qualification, no risk shutdown, number of profitable blocks, worst block net/worst drawdown, total net, id. Freeze top four base-ranked cases before 2x training cost stress. Select one qualified base/stress survivor, otherwise no promoted candidate. Minimum 60 trades per block, positive each block, no shutdown, close/intrabar DD <20000 actual NQ dollars. No validation or test replay in this script.
protocol.limitations: This is in-training research and repeated hypothesis search; internal blocks are not untouched external confirmation. NQ has real mini economics and 10x micro risk budgets, not synthetic early MNQ P&L. The researcher retains prior validation/test knowledge; outcomes cannot remove that contamination. Configured risk stops may be exceeded by gaps.

uncertainty.method: Circular session block bootstrap; weak stationarity assumed; not future probability
